lines.en: Mom, let's go to the sea this summer.
Good idea! Which beach do you like?
The one on the east coast. It's quiet.
We went there ten years ago. Remember?
lines.ko: 십 년 전에 거기 갔었어요. 기억나요?

lines.en: Yes! I swam in the waves all day.
Will the children like the sand and shells?
Sure. They will look for fish in the water.
Sometimes the ocean wind is cold. Bring warm clothes.
lines.ko: 가끔 바닷바람이 차요. 따뜻한 옷을 가져가요.

lines.en: Okay. Can you make some food for the trip?
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 여행 음식 좀 만들어 줄래요?

lines.en: Sure. I will cook a lot for everyone.
Grandma, look! Here is a big shell!
lines.ko: 할머니, 봐요! 여기 큰 조개껍데기가 있어요!

lines.en: It's beautiful! Are there more here?
Yes, near the waves. Come and see!
Be careful. The sand is wet there.
Can I swim in the sea now?
Not now. The ocean is cold today.
lines.ko: 지금은 안 돼요. 오늘 바다가 차요.

lines.en: Last summer I swam here with Dad.
I know. Sometimes the water is warm in summer.
Will we see fish on the coast tomorrow?
lines.ko: 내일 해안에서 물고기를 볼 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Yes. We will walk on the beach early.
lines.ko: 네. 아침 일찍 해변을 걸을 거예요.
